note: RAIL-10, AE-58: what the deployment has switched on, read once per GM-mode load. Every switch is off until the owner approves a provider (record 3.3). The registry (registry.json, capabilities) names the same switches, with the reason a disabled tool shows; a client strips a switch it does not know, because its registry cannot name a tool for it.

valid.name: the pilot's defaults: nothing approved yet
a client strips a switch a newer server added

invalid.name: a switch as text
invalid.why: no coercion: a switch is a boolean

invalid.name: a switch left out
invalid.why: every switch the registry names is answered, so absence can never be mistaken for off

invalid.name: a switch the registry does not name
invalid.why: the server emits exactly the registry's switches; adding one is a registry change first
